rows.question: Find all photometrically observable star that have spectral observations. Retrieve the object id, right ascension, and declination.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photoobj_core AS (
SELECT
  objid,
  ra,
  dec
FROM photoobj
WHERE objid IS NOT NULL
  AND ra IS NOT NULL
  AND dec IS NOT NULL
  AND clean IS NOT NULL
  AND clean <> 0
),
specobj_linkage_by_objid AS (
SELECT
  -- linked object id (from photoobj_core or from specobj.bestobjid when linking to spectra-only rows)
  linked.objid AS linked_objid,

  -- specobj linkage columns (may be null if the source is a spectrum-only table)
  s.specobjid AS specobj_specobjid,
  s.bestobjid AS specobj_bestobjid,

  -- direct spectrum-only table keys (null unless that source is present)
  g.specobjid AS galspecline_specobjid,
  p.specobjid AS spplines_specobjid

FROM
  (
    -- Start from photo objects to get direct object -> spectrum links via specobj.bestobjid
    SELECT
      pc.objid
    FROM photoobj_core pc
  ) AS linked

  -- left join to specobj by bestobjid to capture spectra linked to photo objects
  LEFT JOIN specobj s
    ON s.bestobjid = linked.objid

  -- left join to galspecline by specobjid to include spectra-only records;
  -- also preserves rows where specobj is null but a galspecline record exists for the same specobjid.
  LEFT JOIN galspecline g
    ON g.specobjid = s.specobjid

  -- left join to spplines similarly
  LEFT JOIN spplines p
    ON p.specobjid = s.specobjid

UNION ALL

-- Include spectrum-only rows from galspecline that do not have any associated photoobj via specobj.bestobjid.
SELECT
  NULL::bigint AS linked_objid,
  NULL::numeric AS specobj_specobjid,
  NULL::bigint AS specobj_bestobjid,
  g2.specobjid AS galspecline_specobjid,
  NULL::numeric AS spplines_specobjid
FROM galspecline g2
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM specobj s2 WHERE s2.specobjid = g2.specobjid AND s2.bestobjid IS NOT NULL
)

UNION ALL

-- Include spectrum-only rows from spplines that do not have any associated photoobj via specobj.bestobjid
SELECT
  NULL::bigint AS linked_objid,
  NULL::numeric AS specobj_specobjid,
  NULL::bigint AS specobj_bestobjid,
  NULL::numeric AS galspecline_specobjid,
  p2.specobjid AS spplines_specobjid
FROM spplines p2
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM specobj s3 WHERE s3.specobjid = p2.specobjid AND s3.bestobjid IS NOT NULL
)
)
SELECT p.objid,
       p.ra,
       p.dec
FROM photoobj_core p
JOIN specobj_linkage_by_objid s
  ON p.objid = s.linked_objid
WHERE s.specobj_specobjid IS NOT NULL
   OR s.specobj_bestobjid IS NOT NULL
   OR s.galspecline_specobjid IS NOT NULL
   OR s.spplines_specobjid IS NOT NULL

  SELECT
    p.objid AS objid,
    NULLIF(p.ra, 'NaN'::double precision) AS ra,
    NULLIF(p.dec, 'NaN'::double precision) AS dec,
    p.type AS type
  FROM photoobj p
),
photo_type_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    pt.value AS value,
    pt.name AS name
  FROM photo_type pt
),
spectra_to_photo_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid AS specobjid,
    s.bestobjid AS bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
)

FROM photoobj_core p

WHERE t.name = 'STAR'
  AND p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.objid
